key_insight: A coupled prediction-and-selection workflow with uncertainty estimation and physics-based filtering enables more reliable out-of-distribution discovery of ionic liquids for targeted performance.
engineering_relevance: This approach helps engineers screen synthesizable ionic liquids for CO2 capture using trade-offs that matter in practice, such as solubility, viscosity, and working capacity.
method: Clean and structure sparse, noisy ionic liquid property data for model training.
Use deep learning to predict properties with uncertainty awareness.
Apply physics-based calculations and Pareto filtering to rank and down-select candidates.
evidence_signal: The workflow is demonstrated on novel ionic liquid design for flue-gas CO2 capture, with candidate selection based on predicted property trade-offs rather than point estimates alone.
watch_item: Performance may still depend strongly on the limited coverage and uneven quality of available ionic liquid measurements, especially under out-of-distribution conditions.
paper_title: Comprehensive Workflow for Uncertainty-Aware Ionic Liquid Solvent Discovery
